description:
## Finding

99 occurrences across the workspace use the type's own name inside `impl` blocks where `Self` would be more idiomatic. Clippy's `clippy::use_self` flags every one.

## Examples

```
pkix-lint/src/lib.rs:376:13
            LintResult::Pass => f.write_str("Pass"),
            ^^^^^^^^^^ help: use the applicable keyword: `Self`

pkix-lint/src/lib.rs:377:13
            LintResult::NotApplicable => f.write_str("NotApplicable"),

pkix-path/src/lib.rs:1540:18 (and many others in same impl blocks)
```

## Distribution

Sample by crate (count of `unnecessary structure name repetition` warnings):

- pkix-lint: ~50+ (LintResult, DeviationAddError, DeviationAction, Deviation, etc.)
- pkix-path: ~25 (Error, NcTypeMask)
- pkix-revocation: ~15
- others: scattered

## Fix

Mechanical — `cargo clippy --fix --workspace -- -W clippy::use_self` handles most. Best to do alongside the `clippy::doc_markdown` cleanup (separate finding) since both are bulk autofix passes.

## Priority

P3 — bulk idiom fix; not a bug. Filed as one issue rather than 99 because the fix is uniform.
title: P3: 99 instances of clippy::use_self across workspace (Type::Variant inside impl blocks)
